byte_binding: Eight reviewed files equal the exact v8 source capsule; counts use the pinned prepared manifest, not live fit results.

caps.after_drop: capture/model digest/range/padding/seen counters still run; individual posterior records are not retained.
caps.footer: dropped=seen-retained; truncated iff dropped>0. Missing end footer is rejected by read_trace; no complete coverage inferred from a header alone.
caps.scope: Chronological retained prefix, not random or stratified sampling.
caps.stopping: First reached record/byte budget fixes drop_reason and stops all subsequent retention; byte check reserves 16384 bytes for footer.

capture_semantics.call_point: Inside HCSNCore.forward after the complete sequence has been evaluated, before returning logits to loss/backward; all microbatches precede the one effective-batch optimizer step.
capture_semantics.capture: One completed microbatch forward, including padded time positions in the returned trace.
capture_semantics.configuration_binding: Each visit carries GridSpec, physical values, operator configuration; header binds data manifest and fit-plan SHA; complete trainer/runtime identity comes from the separate fit source ledger.
capture_semantics.episode_id: Ordered microbatch episode IDs joined with '+', interpreted with batch_indices and the update journal.
capture_semantics.expected_events: Conditional expected interval count from the preceding flow, before current observation conditioning.
capture_semantics.model_sha256: Tensor digest of the inner ContinuousSpikingNetwork state_dict; not the full CoreStudyModel, optimizer or checkpoint file SHA.
capture_semantics.partial_failure_scope: Only completed capture calls are represented. A forward that fails before capture can have unrecorded internal visits; a captured forward can also precede a later failed backward or optimizer attempt.
capture_semantics.posterior: Current probability after the interval flow and current observation conditioning.
capture_semantics.prior: Previous conditioned probability at the interval start, or the reset initial state at position zero; not the after-flow pre-conditioning prior.
capture_semantics.record: One (capture, time position, layer) with at least one valid sample; contains vectors for every valid sample in that microbatch.
capture_semantics.state_window: HCSNCore resets initial_state for every independent input window; no carry across dataset windows.
capture_semantics.update_index: Number of completed main optimizer updates before the current attempted effective batch, zero-based; all its microbatches share this index.

final_model_export: A later fixed-window forward from a trained checkpoint is supplemental final-model evaluation, not the original training access trace. Bind checkpoint/file+tensor/config/data/window/hash identities separately.

padding_semantics.all_padding_position: No visit record and no seen-record increment, but excluded sample-position-layer counts still increase.
padding_semantics.batch_indices: Microbatch-local valid row indices, excluding padding.
padding_semantics.builder: x=0, dt=0, y=-1 after each episode's true length; all microbatches retain the original effective-batch padded length.
padding_semantics.mask: valid=x[...,12:24].bool().any(-1); the same mask is passed as observed and valid_mask.
padding_semantics.padded_states_excluded: Number of masked-out sample-position-layer states over completed captures; not visit-record count.
padding_semantics.padding_validation: Recorder requires masked-out dt and network predictions to be exactly zero.
